scientific.integrity: The zero-momentum, zero-smoothing Padam recurrence is reduced exactly to a one-dimensional max-memory system. A normalized historical-maximum variable obeys an explicit scalar map whose invariant-region and crossing behavior change sharply at exponent one quarter.
limitations: The theorem is a boundary specialization with zero momentum and zero second-moment smoothing.
It uses a fixed learning rate and no denominator epsilon.
For exponents above one quarter, isolated exact-hit resonances can still produce a two-cycle.

title: Sharp partial-adaptivity phase transition in scalar Padam
